mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,project_id,upload_id,operation_id,event_id,consumer_id,input_sha256,scan_command,scan_receipt, write_intent,object_ref,status,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,created_by,created_at,classification,revision,updated_at FROM source_completion_checkpoint WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND consumer_id=#{consumerId} AND upload_id=#{uploadId} AND operation_id=#{operationId} AND created_by=#{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.source_id,sv.source_version,s.owner_project_id,s.ownership,s.classification,sv.rights_revision, sv.original_sha256,sv.object_key,sv.object_version,sv.media_type,sv.size_bytes,sv.provenance FROM source_dedup d JOIN source_version sv ON sv.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND sv.source_version=d.source_version JOIN source s ON s.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND s.source_id=sv.source_id WHERE d.ownership_scope_id=#{ownershipScopeId} AND d.original_sha256=#{artifactSha256} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no),0) FROM source_version WHERE source_id=#{sourceId}

SELECT r.result_ref FROM consumer_receipt r JOIN outbox_event e ON e.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND e.event_id=r.event_id WHERE e.aggregate_id=#{uploadId} AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.payload,'$.operation_id'))=#{operationId} AND e.event_type='source.upload.completion.requested' AND r.consumer_id='SOURCE_UPLOAD_COMPLETION' AND r.created_by=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT event_id,completion_started_at,completion_deadline,completion_manifest FROM outbox_delivery WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND consumer_id=#{consumerId} AND created_by=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE upload_item SET status='FAILED',revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE upload_id=#{uploadId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND created_by=#{userId} AND status='UPLOADING' AND revision=#{sourceRevision}
